name: HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings S.A.
summary: HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the energy sector in Greece, the Southeastern Europe, and the East Mediterranean. It operates through Refining, Supply and Trading; Marketing; Production and Trading of Petrochemicals; Power; Exploration and Production of Hydrocarbons; and Electromobility segments. The company engages in the refining, supply, and trading of crude oil and petroleum products; marketing of fuels; wholesale trading of oil products; production and marketing of polypropylene, BOPP/cast films, and solvents; trading of imported plastics and chemicals; and production, trading, and supply of power.
